summary: Frontend-only test of the 3 /area changes using a seeded fresh user (2 contracts + 2 invoices, 7 credits; cleaned up afterwards). Used 1 real AI call (deep audit). (1) Credits pill works: shows 7 = /api/auth/me, and after the deep audit it updates to 6 with no page reload (window marker kept, no navigation); the panel shows 'Crediti residui: 6' and /api/auth/me returns 6. (2) Audit labels work: contracts show 'Data di scadenza', 'Data di decorrenza', 'Durata', 'Parte 1 › Nome', 'Parte 1 › P.IVA / CF', 'Promemoria 1 › Data'; invoices show 'Fornitore › P.IVA', 'Cliente › Nome', 'Totali › Totale', 'Documento › Numero'; unknown key invoice_number shows as 'Invoice number'; no raw snake_case in deterministic finding titles. (3) DateField works: it is a button with placeholder gg/mm/aaaa; the calendar is Italian (ottobre 2026, lun..dom, week starts on Monday); picking a day shows dd/mm/yyyy and closes the popup; Aggiungi creates the deadline and lists it as 15/11/2026; edit -> 20/11/2026 saved; a DA VERIFICARE deadline gets a date, then Conferma -> Confermata 10/11/2026. Inside doc-panel the calendar sits above the panel (popper z 300 vs panel 200, elementFromPoint confirmed). Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). No console errors; all 4 tabs load. MAIN PROBLEM: the calendar has no styling because Tailwind is not active in this project.

ui_bugs.issue: The calendar has no styling. ROOT CAUSE: no CSS file in the project has @tailwind directives (index.css and App.css are plain CSS), so every Tailwind class in components/ui/calendar.jsx and popover.jsx does nothing (h-8 w-8, flex rows, buttonVariants, p-3, z-50). Result: tiny day cells with browser-default white button backgrounds and borders, weekday header squashed into 'lunmarmergiovensabdom', white default nav buttons, no padding. It works, but looks broken and unprofessional on desktop and mobile.

Clicking the day that is already selected deselects it: react-day-picker single mode calls onSelect(undefined), the value becomes '' and the button goes back to 'gg/mm/aaaa'. When editing, Salva then sends due_date undefined, so the old date is silently kept while the UI showed it as empty. Reproduced on mobile in doc-panel edit.

issues: The label input is narrow and its placeholder 'Nuova scadenza manuale' is cut off; the calendar is aligned to the right screen edge (x 180-390), so it touches the edge with no margin

The AI-written descriptions and the source lines under them still show technical keys and raw JSON (e.g. 'parties: [{"name": ...}]', 'expiration_date: "01/12/2026"', 'invoice_number'). This is outside the fieldLabel change, but the user wanted no technical keys in the audit. Consider passing labelled fields to the prompt, or formatting the sources with fieldLabel.

action_items: Style the calendar without Tailwind: write .ws-cal CSS for react-day-picker v8 classNames (pass custom classNames such as rdp table/row/cell/day/nav and style them in workspace.css), or import 'react-day-picker/dist/style.css' and override the colours for the dark theme. Do NOT add @tailwind base globally: preflight would restyle the whole app.
In DateField, ignore an undefined onSelect (keep the current value) or pass required to Calendar, so re-clicking the selected day does not clear the date.
Optional: humanize keys in the deep audit sources and prompt output; on mobile, give the deadline add form full-width rows.
critical_code_review_comments: calendar.jsx and popover.jsx depend fully on Tailwind utilities that are never compiled in this project. Any other shadcn component used in /area will have the same no-styling problem.
Workspace.jsx fetches /api/auth/me only on mount. The credits pill does not update after other credit-spending actions unless they call setCredits (fine for now).

success_rate.frontend: 90% functional (all flows pass); calendar visual styling fails

seed_data_creation: A fresh test_iter25_*@example.com user with 4 TEST_ analyses was created and fully cleaned up (analyses, reminders, clients, audits, user).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use 'python /app/backend/tests/seed_iter25_ui.py seed' to create the user (writes /tmp/iter25.json with token and uid; set localStorage da_token/da_uid), and 'seed_iter25_ui.py clean' to remove it. The deep audit was already verified (7->6 credits, no reload). Do not spend another AI call; only retest calendar styling and the re-click deselect fix.
rca of the issue: Calendar styling: no @tailwind directives exist anywhere in src, so shadcn's className-based styling compiles to nothing; only the inline Radix popper styles and the custom .ws-cal rules apply. Deselect: DayPicker mode='single' toggles the selection off on a second click, and DateField maps undefined to ''.
